label: Full-time · Bachelor's
short: 2 event days: Thursday and Friday, 1-2 October.

days.title: Day 1 · Thursday, 1 October
items: From 9:00: campus walk in 4 rounds - time and room depend on your programme and group
11:00-18:00: stands of the Student Union, student organisations and science clubs
11:00-17:00: attractions at Zaprzegubie (chill zone, giant games, DJ), then 17:00-21:00 the after - a warm-up before UE Party

days.title: Day 2 · Friday, 2 October
items: From 9:00: talks on student rights and duties
From 22:00: UE Party x DA at Jamaica club

label: Full-time · Master's

days.title: Day 1 · Thursday, 1 October
items: From 9:00: talks for Master's students on student rights and duties
11:00-21:00: stands of the Student Union, student organisations and science clubs, attractions and an after-party at Zaprzegubie

days.title: Friday, 2 October
items: From 22:00: UE Party x DA at Jamaica club
